fields.name: markets
fields.description:
Returns a paginated list of [`Market`](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/admin-graphql/latest/objects/Market) objects configured for the shop. Markets match buyers based on defined conditions to deliver customized shopping experiences.

Filter markets by [`MarketType`](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/admin-graphql/latest/enums/MarketType) and [`MarketStatus`](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/admin-graphql/latest/enums/MarketStatus), search by name, and control sort order. Retrieve market configurations including [`MarketCurrencySettings`](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/admin-graphql/latest/objects/MarketCurrencySettings), [`MarketWebPresence`](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/admin-graphql/latest/objects/Mark

fields.name: marketsResolvedValues
fields.description: The resolved values for a buyer signal.

fields.name: productsCount
fields.description: Count of products. Limited to a maximum of 10000 by default.

fields.name: publications
fields.description:
Returns a paginated list of [`Publication`](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/admin-graphql/latest/objects/Publication).

Filter publications by [`CatalogType`](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/admin-graphql/latest/enums/CatalogType).

fields.name: shop
fields.description:
Returns the Shop resource corresponding to the access token used in the request. The Shop resource contains
business and store management settings for the shop.

fields.name: shopLocales
fields.description:
Returns the locales enabled on a shop. Each locale represents a language for translations and determines how content displays to customers in different markets.

Use the optional `published` argument to filter for only the locales that are visible to customers. The response includes the ISO locale code, whether it's the shop's primary locale, and which [`MarketWebPresence`](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/admin-graphql/latest/objects/MarketWebPresence) objects use each locale.

fields.name: catalogs
fields.description: The catalogs that belong to the market.

fields.name: catalogsCount
fields.description: The number of catalogs that belong to the market.

fields.name: conditions
fields.description: The conditions under which a visitor is in the market.

fields.name: currencySettings
fields.description: The market’s currency settings.

fields.name: handle
fields.description: A short, human-readable unique identifier for the market. This is changeable by the merchant.

fields.name: id
fields.description: A globally-unique ID.

fields.name: name
fields.description: The name of the market. Not shown to customers.

fields.name: status
fields.description: Status of the market. Replaces the enabled field.

fields.name: type
fields.description: The type of the market.

fields.name: webPresences
fields.description:
The market’s web presences, which defines its SEO strategy. This can be a different domain,
subdomain, or subfolders of the primary domain. Each web presence comprises one or more
language variants. If a market doesn't have any web presences, then the market is accessible on the
primary market's domains using [country
selectors](https://shopify.dev/themes/internationalization/multiple-currencies-languages#the-country-selector).

fields.name: alternateLocales
fields.description:
The ShopLocale object for the alternate locales. When a domain is used, these locales will be
available as language-specific subfolders. For example, if English is an
alternate locale, and `example.ca` is the market’s domain, then
`example.ca/en` will load in English.

fields.name: defaultLocale
fields.description:
The ShopLocale object for the default locale. When a domain is used, this is the locale that will
be used when the domain root is accessed. For example, if French is the default locale,
and `example.ca` is the market’s domain, then `example.ca` will load in French.

fields.name: domain
fields.description:
The web presence’s domain.
This field will be null if `subfolderSuffix` isn't null.

fields.name: id
fields.description: A globally-unique ID.

fields.name: markets
fields.description: The associated markets for this web presence.

fields.name: rootUrls
fields.description: The list of root URLs for each of the web presence’s locales. As of version `2024-04` this value will no longer have a trailing slash.

fields.name: subfolderSuffix
fields.description: The market-specific suffix of the subfolders defined by the web presence. Example: in `/en-us` the subfolder suffix is `us`. This field will be null if `domain` isn't null.

fields.name: locale
fields.description: The locale ISO code.

fields.name: marketWebPresences
fields.description: The market web presences that use the locale.

fields.name: name
fields.description: The human-readable locale name.

fields.name: primary
fields.description: Whether the locale is the default locale for the shop.

fields.name: published
fields.description: Whether the locale is visible to buyers.

fields.name: conditionTypes
fields.description: The set of condition types that are defined for the market.

fields.name: regionsCondition
fields.description: The region conditions that determine whether a visitor is in the market.

fields.name: baseCurrency
fields.description: The currency which this market's customers must use if local currencies are disabled.

fields.name: localCurrencies
fields.description:
Whether or not local currencies are enabled. If enabled, then prices will
be converted to give each customer the best experience based on their
region. If disabled, then all customers in this market will see prices
in the market's base currency.

fields.name: roundingEnabled
fields.description: Whether or not rounding is enabled on multi-currency prices.

fields.name: code
fields.description: The ISO code identifying the country.

fields.name: currency
fields.description: The currency which this country uses given its market settings.

fields.description: A globally-unique ID.

fields.description: The name of the region.

fields.description: A globally-unique ID.

fields.description: The web presence of the domain.

fields.description: The URL of the domain (for example, `[DOCUMENTATION_EXAMPLE_URL]`).

fields.name: countriesInShippingZones
fields.description: Countries that have been defined in shipping zones for the shop.

fields.description: The three letter code for the currency that the shop sells in.

fields.name: enabledPresentmentCurrencies
fields.description: The presentment currencies enabled for the shop.

fields.name: id
fields.description: A globally-unique ID.

fields.name: name
fields.description: The shop's name.

fields.name: primaryDomain
fields.description: The primary domain of the shop's online store.

fields.name: shipsToCountries
fields.description: The list of countries that the shop ships to.

fields.name: applicationLevel
fields.description: The application level for the condition.

fields.name: regions
fields.description: The regions that comprise the market.

fields.name: currencyCode
fields.description: The currency's ISO code.

fields.name: enabled
fields.description: Whether the currency is enabled or not. An enabled currency setting is visible to buyers and allows orders to be generated with that currency as presentment.

fields.name: countryCodes
fields.description: The list of all the countries from all the combined shipping zones.

fields.name: includeRestOfWorld
fields.description: Whether 'Rest of World' has been defined in any of the shipping zones.

fields.name: alternateLocales
fields.description: The ISO codes for the domain’s alternate locales. For example, `["en"]`.

fields.name: country
fields.description: The ISO code for the country assigned to the domain. For example, `"CA"` or "*" for a domain set to "Rest of world".

fields.name: defaultLocale
fields.description: The ISO code for the domain’s default locale. For example, `"en"`.

fields.name: autoPublish
fields.description: Whether new products are automatically published to this publication.

fields.description: The count of products included in the publication. Limited to a maximum of 10000 by default.
